description: A vulnerability was detected in SourceCodester Online Leave Management System 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file app/classes/Master.php of the component Employee Avatar Upload Extension. Performing a manipulation of the argument employee avatar filename results in cross site scripting. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used.
